newsitem.title: USA: Vinik group has 5.2 pct Consolidated stake.
newsitem.headline: Vinik group has 5.2 pct Consolidated stake.

text.p: A group led by former Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said Friday it has acquired a 5.2 percent stake in Consolidated Graphics Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission the group said it paid $12.6 million for 318,600 common shares of Consolidated and holds the stake for investment purposes.
The group said its stake includes 119,200 shares purchased between November 1 and 20 at prices ranging from $36.29 to $42.7037 a share.
The group includes hedge fund Vinik Asset Mangement and Vinik Partners LP, which are based in Boston.
Consolidated Graphics is a Houston, Texas,-based commercial printing company.
